onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/properties/state_sync.schema.json, set an_c_grounded_mode to {{an_c_grounded_mode}}]
Set the grounded detection sensitivity to {{an_c_grounded_mode}} for animation blending. Tight=threshold 0.2. Normal=0.8. Loose=1.5.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/properties/state_sync.schema.json, set an_t_grounded_threshold to {{an_t_grounded_threshold}}]
Set AnimationController.groundedThreshold to {{an_t_grounded_threshold}}. Used for IsRecentlyGrounded blend variable. Current: grounded_mode={{an_c_grounded_mode}}
